# Northbridge Casino — General Terms and Conditions

These terms apply to every account at northbridge.example, operated by Northbridge Gaming Ltd. Northbridge Gaming Ltd is licensed and regulated by the Malta Gaming Authority under licence number MGA/B2C/000/2020.

1.3 Using a VPN, proxy or any other means to mask your location is not permitted and any balance obtained this way will be forfeited.

4.3 Betting patterns that place opposite bets on the same outcome, or low-risk betting to complete wagering, are considered irregular play and will void the bonus and associated winnings.

5. Responsible Gambling

5.1 You can set deposit limits, take a time-out or self-exclude at any time from your account settings.
